fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: UTC time when the security event occurred.
fields.justification: Needed to build a chronological incident timeline and correlate events from different sources.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify which asset generated or was affected by the event.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Type of telemetry source that produced the event.
fields.justification: Needed to preserve source attribution and allow analysts to filter events by telemetry type.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Origin of the record such as evidence_pack or student_telemetry.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish baseline evidence from telemetry added by the student.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category such as authentication, process, network, file, or audit.
fields.justification: Needed by detection and triage workflows to group similar events independently of their original source.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Source-specific identifier for the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify important source-specific events such as Windows Event IDs without losing original meaning.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity level associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to prioritize events during detection and analyst triage.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived from event_id or event content

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to investigate authentication activity and actions performed by specific accounts.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or path of the process associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to detect and investigate suspicious process execution.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Operating system process identifier associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to correlate multiple events generated by the same running process.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address associated with a network-related event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the system that initiated a connection or suspicious network activity.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish network sessions and support connection-level investigation.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address associated with a network-related event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify which system or service was contacted by the source.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination network port associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the destination service involved in network activity.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network or application protocol associated with the event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish activities such as TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS, and HTTP during investigation.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original human-readable event message preserved from the source.
fields.justification: Needed to retain source fidelity and allow analysts to inspect details not captured by normalized fields.

source_mapping.network_json: original event serialized as text or message field

fields.name: source_fields
fields.description: Source-specific fields preserved from the original event.
fields.justification: Needed to prevent useful source-specific evidence from being lost during normalization.
